scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @mcsm/contracts && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @mcsm/api" "npm run dev --workspace @mcsm/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @mcsm/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @mcsm/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
